avis.texte: I'll cleanse with mugwarts cleanser. I use this product as a nightly mask. It works so good. I had a few stubborn pimples that pop up every other day.. and this eliminated them all!! A cheap and very good product!! I don't notice a smell.

I dont normally do reviews where I write something but wanted to leave a FYI! Ive only used this product twice, both times as a mask instead of a cleanser. I have dehydrated, sensitive, acne prone skin and this has not made me sensitive or gave me acne the next day. I feel like it is a nice refreshing quick mask to throw on before hopping in the shower (directions say 1-2 mins before washing off) but I dont think ive used it enough to notice huge differences! I want to mention just a few FYI's. First is the smell, it straight up smells like if Windex and toilet bowl cleaner had a baby. Once you wash it off the smell fades but WOW its a very intense ammonia scent. Second, the mochi texture truly feels so luxurious when applying it like a mask but I found it to almost be too stringy? Where if you lift your hand off your face to spread the product elsewhere, a giant stringy pieces follows you lol it got all over my eyelashes and on my shirt. Not a huge deal but just kind of a messy application process! Id also say washing this off in the shower would be the most ideal. It took me a while to remove! Finally, after I washed it off, my skin felt so clean it was almost hard to move my hands around on my face? I have no other way to explain it except if you were trying to rub a piece of silicon and your hand grips it and tugs weirdly? That may make no sense but again, just a FYI! I dont know if I will purchase again because self care for me needs to have a phenomenal sensorial experi

I LOVEEE this mask. It's perfect. Great price point. It's brightening and keeps my skin looking and feeling super smooth. It's pretty gentle and not irritating at all. It has really good ingredients and the texture is unique and fun. The smell is a little medicinal because of the tea tree and peppermint ingredients, but it's not unbearable. I would 10/10 recommend this product, I'll definitely be repurchasing in the future.

I love this cleanser. It didn't cause my sensative skin to react and left it feeling super clean, soft, and not dry. I also noticed a huge improvement in my pores. The only thing I didn't like is the smell. It smells a bit like cleaner but fades quickly.
